title: Hoag Champions Innovation as Presenting Sponsor of Greater Irvine Chamber's Innovator's Journey
snippet: The Greater Irvine Chamber's Innovator's Journey program will feature keynote speaker Errol Arkilic, chief innovation officer at UC Irvine and executive director of UCI Beall Applied Innovation. The event will explore how leaders are transforming breakthrough ideas into real-world impact through entrepreneurship, responsible AI, digital transformation, and emerging technologies.
match_reason: websearch (publication) — Errol Arkilic is the featured keynote speaker of the Innovator's Journey event highlighted in this article, which focuses on responsible AI and emerging technologies.
